title: Assign the orphan course
statementMd:
Assign teacher 5 to every course that has no teacher, then list the courses taught by teacher 5.

Expected columns: `title`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `UPDATE courses SET teacher_id = 5 WHERE teacher_id IS NULL`.
solutionMd:
```sql
UPDATE courses SET teacher_id = 5 WHERE teacher_id IS NULL; SELECT title FROM courses WHERE teacher_id = 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
